# pvescheduler_node (Data Source)

Evaluates all PVE nodes on every plan and returns the currently least-loaded one. Use pvescheduler_placement to lock in a decision instead.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cpu_weight` (Number) Weight applied to CPU utilization when scoring nodes (default 0.3).
- `exclude` (List of String) Node names to exclude from scheduling.
- `memory_weight` (Number) Weight applied to memory utilization when scoring nodes (default 0.7).

### Read-Only

- `cpu_usage_pct` (Number) CPU utilization of the selected node as a percentage (0-100).
- `memory_usage_pct` (Number) Memory utilization of the selected node as a percentage (0-100).
- `node_name` (String) The name of the selected Proxmox node.
